notes:
- Feature: several trades open at once. New setting "Trades open at once" (default 3, 1 to 10; 1 = the old one-at-a-time). The bot only waits while it is placing a trade (the click and the broker's confirmation), not for the whole expiry. A new trade is also held back when the trades still running could push past the loss stop (losses in a row, including the strategy's 3-loss rule, or the daily stop-loss), so several open trades can never overshoot it.
- Fix: a failed news calendar fetch is retried after 5 minutes instead of 30 (strategies that avoid news give no signal until it loads).
- Checked live: the keep-awake tone makes Chrome show the speaker icon on the armed Quotex tab, so the tab is not throttled in the background.
